title: Introduce microprofile-curator: tenant-prefill defaults catalog and quant-signalizer
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a new microprofile-curator service that synthesizes tenant-aware prefill defaults and a lightweight quant-signalizer for monitoring quantization impact. Includes a dry-run CLI, safety gates, and telemetry exports for Console. Backwards-compatible; no customer action required.
description:
Context & motivation: Customers continue to see unpredictable unit economics when tenant-level workload shapes are mapped to a single global set of prefill/batching/quant defaults. This leads to cost spikes, overly aggressive quantization rollouts, and noisy perf regressions. This PR introduces 'microprofile-curator' — a small runtime and CLI that synthesizes compact tenant-specific prefill defaults and emits a continuous 'quant-signal' metric stream so we can detect when quant profiles change output-latency/cost behavior.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Adds a new microservice (pkg/microprofile_curator) plus a small operational CLI (bin/microprofile-curator) that: 1) ingests sampled request metadata (shape, sequence_length, kv-cache-hit, token_distribution) and builds compact 'microprofiles' per tenant; 2) applies a ruleset to suggest prefill/batching/quant defaults with safety margins; 3) provides a dry-run mode to simulate expected unit-econ impact using existing cost models; 4) exposes a Prometheus metrics endpoint and emits structured telemetry (quant_signal.{tenant}.{profile}) to Console; 5) ships a quant-signalizer that computes drift scores and annotates model-version rollouts to prevent blind quant rollouts. The implementation is intentionally conservative: suggestions are non-blocking, surfaced via API/CLI, and safe by default.

Key implementation notes and files changed (high level): - pkg/microprofile_curator/service.go: main service logic, microprofile schema and aggregation window. - pkg/curator/rules.go: rule engine that maps microprofiles to defaults (batch_size, prefill_k, quant_profile). - bin/microprofile-curator: operational CLI with subcommands `analyze`, `dry-run`, `apply --preview`, `export`. - telemetry/quant_signalizer.go: drift scorer, histogram snapshots, exported labels compatible with Console ingestion. - api/handlers/curator_v1.go: lightweight API to fetch suggestions and preview simulations. - integrations/console/exporter.yaml: telemetry export template for Console dashboards. - test/*: unit tests for rule edgecases, a small integration smoke test that runs dry-run against the cost-sim harness.

Commits summary: - 7 commits; notable ones: "initial microprofile schema & aggregator", "rule engine with conservative thresholds", "cli + dry-run simulation", "prometheus exporter and quant-signalizer", "tests + docs + sample telemetry dashboard export".

Why this is different from existing defaults: Instead of a one-size-fits-all preset, microprofiles capture tenant micro-shapes (tails, burstiness, kv-hit-rates) and map those to safer batch/cache/quant defaults. The quant-signalizer provides continuous feedback loops so human reviewers and the Optimize tooling can detect regressions before automatic rollouts reach production.

Safety / rollback plan: Suggestions are non-authoritative. `apply` requires `--preview` and an approval step; we added explicit rate-limits in the curator so it cannot mass-apply changes. Quant recommendations are annotated with an expected cost delta and a risk_score; any suggestion with risk_score > 0.6 is marked as manual-review. Telemetry includes a suggested expiration TTL for defaults to encourage re-evaluation.

Checklist: - [x] Schema, aggregator, and persistence (in-memory + optional persistent backend) - [x] Rule engine with unit tests for edge cases - [x] Dry-run cost simulation harness wired to existing econ models - [x] Telemetry metrics and Console exporter - [x] CLI and docs + example dashboard export - [x] Integration smoke tests and CI coverage

Files changed (representative list): pkg/microprofile_curator/service.go, pkg/curator/rules.go, bin/microprofile-curator/main.go, telemetry/quant_signalizer.go, api/handlers/curator_v1.go, integrations/console/exporter.yaml, docs/curator.md, test/curator_rules_test.go, test/quant_signalizer_integration_test.go, Makefile updates for building CLI.

Review notes & known limitations: - Current aggregator uses a single fixed window (5m) and decays; we note in code where to plumb tenant-configurable windows (follow-up ENG-1499). - Persistence is optional; initial rollout uses in-memory with checkpoint exports to S3 for stateful tenants. Follow-up will add Cassandra/PG backends if necessary. - Dry-run cost model assumes current pricebook; significant infra price changes may skew sim results (we've added a flag to override pricebook in the CLI).

Related work and references: Linked Linear: ENG-1421 (microprofile curator prototype), ENG-1422 (quant signal schema). Related PRs: this is intended to be complementary to the prefill-policy-importer CLI and the unit-econ simulator; cross-team follow-up will connect results into Redwood Optimize.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals and a green CI run.
